name: Reed-Excitation Instruments
mechanism: Couple a flexible vibrating reed to a qualified resonating air passage
operating_requirement: Suitable reed material, shaped passage and player practice
consequence: Produce a controllable sound family with reed wear and response limits

name: Bowed-String Excitation
mechanism: Sustain string vibration through controlled frictional interaction with a moving bow
operating_requirement: Qualified string, bow surface and practiced control
consequence: Support sustained and articulated tones without guaranteeing expressive skill

name: Keyboard Action Mechanisms
mechanism: Translate key motion into a controlled instrument excitation or valve action
operating_requirement: Actual linkages, return elements, alignment and maintenance
consequence: Coordinate repeatable note control with mechanical response limits

name: Pipe-Organ Wind Distribution
mechanism: Distribute regulated air to selected resonating pipes through controlled valves
operating_requirement: Actual air source, wind channels, valves and maintained seals
consequence: Support an instrument array while retaining air and control capacity

name: Fretted-String Intonation
mechanism: Place and qualify stopping points against string length, tension and intended tuning
operating_requirement: Suitable fingerboard, strings, measurement and adjustment
consequence: Support repeatable pitch positions within instrument and tuning compromises

name: Lip-Reed Instrument Design
mechanism: Couple player lip vibration with a shaped resonant air column and mouthpiece
operating_requirement: Qualified geometry, actual material and player technique
consequence: Provide a distinct excitation route while retaining player and acoustic limits

name: Polyphonic Part Composition
mechanism: Compose coordinated simultaneous melodic parts under a declared musical convention
operating_requirement: Competent performers, shared cues and compositional practice
consequence: Support multi-part works without imposing one harmonic tradition

name: Musical Orchestration
mechanism: Assign musical material across instrument ranges, timbres and practical ensemble limits
operating_requirement: Available performers and instruments with known behavior
consequence: Shape ensemble texture without creating absent instrument capacity

name: Musical Transposition
mechanism: Map musical relationships into a different pitch reference while tracking instrument and range limits
operating_requirement: A shared interval convention and competent performers or notation users
consequence: Adapt a work to another qualified range without preserving every timbral effect

name: Tactile Music Notation
mechanism: Encode musical structure in a qualified tactile reading convention
operating_requirement: Readable tactile medium, agreed code and trained readers
consequence: Provide nonvisual score access without automatically teaching performance

name: Dance Movement Notation
mechanism: Record selected body position, direction and timing through a shared movement notation
operating_requirement: Agreed symbols, competent observers and demonstrators
consequence: Preserve specified choreography while retaining unrecorded expressive detail

name: Choreographic Group Patterns
mechanism: Coordinate performer movement and spacing into rehearsable group patterns
operating_requirement: Actual dancers, usable space and shared cues
consequence: Support repeatable group movement without a universal preferred dance form

name: Puppet Linkage Control
mechanism: Map rod, string or joint controls into a constructed figure's intended movement
operating_requirement: Actual articulated figure, control mechanism and practiced operator
consequence: Animate a physical figure within its mechanical limits

name: Stage Blocking and Sightlines
mechanism: Arrange performer positions and movement around audience visibility and dramatic intent
operating_requirement: Actual performance space, performers and rehearsal
consequence: Improve intended visibility without assuming one staging works in every venue

name: Scenic Perspective Construction
mechanism: Construct a staged visual depth effect for a declared audience viewpoint
operating_requirement: Actual scenery, measured venue and controlled viewing assumptions
consequence: Create an intended visual illusion with viewpoint-dependent limits

name: Stage Rigging Systems
mechanism: Suspend and move qualified performance loads through maintained rigging
operating_requirement: Actual rated hardware, structure, trained crew and inspection
consequence: Move scenery or equipment within a verified load and travel envelope

name: Theatrical Cue Coordination
mechanism: Coordinate timed changes in performance, lighting, sound and stage equipment from a shared cue plan
operating_requirement: Actual performers and crew, maintained cue references and rehearsed recovery
consequence: Synchronize a production while retaining missed cues and limited staff

name: Improvisational Rule Systems
mechanism: Define shared constraints that allow performers to generate material during performance
operating_requirement: Practiced participants and an understood interaction convention
consequence: Support responsive creation without preauthoring every event

name: Score-Performance Alignment
mechanism: Relate observed performance events to a declared score while accounting for expressive timing
operating_requirement: Actual score and performance observations with competent interpretation
consequence: Locate passages and deviations without treating interpretation as an error

name: Music Sequencer Control
mechanism: Encode and execute a timed sequence of instrument-control events
operating_requirement: Compatible mechanism or electronics, timing and an actual sound-producing instrument
consequence: Repeat specified event patterns without reproducing all live expression

name: Sound-Synthesis Oscillators
mechanism: Generate and shape controlled electrical audio waveforms as musical material
operating_requirement: Actual oscillators, controls, power and sound-output equipment
consequence: Create a range of synthetic sounds within circuit and playback limits

name: Sampled-Sound Instruments
mechanism: Trigger and transform stored sound fragments through a qualified performance interface
operating_requirement: Actual recordings, storage, playback computation and permissions
consequence: Build an instrument from retained sound while preserving sampling and access limits

name: Spatial Audio Rendering
mechanism: Transform audio into a qualified spatial presentation for a declared listener and playback layout
operating_requirement: Actual channels or headphones, calibration and rendering resources
consequence: Create bounded spatial cues without identical perception in all spaces

name: Motion-Capture Performance
mechanism: Measure performer motion and map it into an evaluated animated or interactive representation
operating_requirement: Actual sensing, calibration, performers and processing
consequence: Transfer selected movement features while retaining occlusion and interpretation errors

name: Volumetric Performance Recording
mechanism: Reconstruct a time-varying spatial representation from qualified multiple views or depth observations
operating_requirement: Actual capture array, calibration, storage and computation
consequence: Support limited viewpoint changes without recording unseen detail automatically

name: Procedural Visual Generation
mechanism: Generate visual form from declared rules and parameters with interpretable author control
operating_requirement: Actual algorithms, rendering resources and authored constraints
consequence: Explore visual variations without automatic artistic merit or provenance certainty

name: Interactive Narrative State Design
mechanism: Represent story-relevant state and conditions for participant-dependent narrative transitions
operating_requirement: Authored content, coherent state rules and observed play
consequence: Support responsive narrative while retaining unreachable or contradictory state risks

name: Performance Latency Compensation
mechanism: Plan timing, buffering or prediction around measured remote performance delays
operating_requirement: Actual links, timing observations and compatible performance design
consequence: Support selected remote collaboration without eliminating propagation delay

name: Multisensory Accessibility Mapping
mechanism: Translate specified artistic cues across sensory presentations with participant feedback
operating_requirement: Actual alternative outputs, skilled interpretation and access consultation
consequence: Expand access to selected features without assuming exact sensory equivalence

name: Collection Environment Control
mechanism: Maintain measured environmental conditions appropriate to identified collection materials
operating_requirement: Actual monitoring, storage enclosure and finite climate-control or passive protection capacity
consequence: Slow selected deterioration while retaining material-specific risks

name: Collection Transport Mounts
mechanism: Support and isolate an identified object against qualified handling and transport loads
operating_requirement: Actual compatible supports, packing, route assessment and trained handlers
consequence: Reduce specified movement damage without guaranteeing loss-free transport

name: Paint-Layer Consolidation
mechanism: Stabilize a failing paint layer with a tested compatible intervention and documented limits
operating_requirement: Qualified conservator, actual compatible material and local trials
consequence: Retain vulnerable material while accepting intervention and aging uncertainty

name: Conservation Surface Cleaning
mechanism: Remove selected unwanted surface material while monitoring the original substrate response
operating_requirement: Qualified tests, compatible tools or media and skilled conservators
consequence: Improve a specified surface condition without assuming all discoloration should be removed

name: Heritage Condition Mapping
mechanism: Locate and compare observed damage or alteration on an identified object or site
operating_requirement: Repeatable references, actual observations and compatible records
consequence: Track condition change without inferring every cause from appearance

name: Archaeological Context Recording
mechanism: Record the spatial association and recovery context of material evidence before disturbance
operating_requirement: Actual surveyed references, controlled records and qualified field staff
consequence: Preserve contextual evidence that object collection alone would lose

name: Stratigraphic Excavation Methods
mechanism: Excavate and document distinguishable deposits while preserving their observed relationships
operating_requirement: Actual site access, skilled excavation and retained samples and records
consequence: Infer relative depositional sequences without assuming every layer is undisturbed

name: Spaced Retrieval Practice
mechanism: Schedule repeated recall attempts separated in time and check retained performance
operating_requirement: Actual learners, retained material and timely feedback
consequence: Improve qualified retention opportunities without guaranteed equal benefit for every task

name: Interleaved Problem Practice
mechanism: Mix problem types so learners must identify which method applies
operating_requirement: Actual suitable exercises, instruction and observed performance
consequence: Practice discrimination among methods while retaining task-dependent effects

name: Worked-Example Fading
mechanism: Progressively remove supplied solution steps as learners demonstrate competence
operating_requirement: Qualified examples, learner observations and instructor time
consequence: Shift responsibility toward independent solving without assuming fixed pacing fits all learners

name: Self-Explanation Prompts
mechanism: Ask learners to explain intermediate choices and relate them to underlying principles
operating_requirement: Actual tasks, interpretable explanations and corrective feedback
consequence: Reveal reasoning gaps without treating fluent explanation as proven performance

name: Learning Error Diagnosis
mechanism: Distinguish recurring error patterns from their possible knowledge or execution causes
operating_requirement: Actual learner attempts, task criteria and qualified observation
consequence: Target corrective instruction while retaining uncertainty about causes

name: Mastery Progression Decisions
mechanism: Advance instruction on demonstrated prerequisite performance rather than elapsed attendance alone
operating_requirement: Valid tasks, actual assessment capacity and continuing teaching access
consequence: Reduce unsupported progression without guaranteeing a perfect competence threshold

name: Transfer-Task Assessment
mechanism: Assess whether learned methods work on meaningfully changed tasks or conditions
operating_requirement: Qualified new tasks and independent performance observation
consequence: Distinguish practiced repetition from demonstrated transfer

name: Metacognitive Calibration Practice
mechanism: Compare learners' confidence predictions with actual later task performance
operating_requirement: Recorded predictions, valid tasks and feedback
consequence: Improve awareness of learning gaps without assuming confidence becomes perfectly accurate

name: Prior-Learning Recognition
mechanism: Assess previously acquired competence against a declared task scope regardless of where it was learned
operating_requirement: Accessible evidence, qualified assessors and actual demonstrations
consequence: Avoid unnecessary repeated instruction without granting competence from claims alone

name: Skill-Decay Measurement
mechanism: Track performance changes after different intervals without practice
operating_requirement: Repeated comparable assessments and actual elapsed-use histories
consequence: Estimate refresher needs without assigning one universal forgetting rate

name: Competence Refresher Triggers
mechanism: Schedule reassessment or retraining from observed decay, task change or prolonged absence
operating_requirement: Maintained records, actual training capacity and valid trigger rules
consequence: Support continuing readiness without perpetual competence from an old credential

name: Learner-State Models
mechanism: Infer qualified competence or misconception states from sequences of observed learning actions
operating_requirement: Actual performance evidence, interpretable model and uncertainty review
consequence: Target instruction while retaining limited visibility into learner knowledge

name: Adaptive Assessment Selection
mechanism: Choose the next assessment task from previous responses under a declared evidence objective
operating_requirement: Calibrated task bank, actual responses and selection resources
consequence: Use limited assessment time more selectively without automatic fairness or accuracy

name: Assessment Item-Response Models
mechanism: Model response probability using declared learner and item properties with checked assumptions
operating_requirement: Representative response data and identifiable model conditions
consequence: Compare task difficulty and evidence without treating a score as all human ability

name: Assessment Reliability Estimation
mechanism: Estimate how scores vary across tasks, occasions or assessors
operating_requirement: Actual repeated or parallel assessments and qualified analysis
consequence: Expose measurement instability rather than mistake every score difference for learning

name: Assessment Bias Review
mechanism: Compare task performance and interpretation across relevant groups while examining access and construct differences
operating_requirement: Representative evidence, qualified reviewers and accountable criteria
consequence: Identify some unfair assessment effects without guaranteeing universal neutrality

name: Training Simulator Model Validation
mechanism: Test whether simulated task responses match the declared real-task training purpose
operating_requirement: Actual reference behavior, qualified scenarios and independent review
consequence: Bound simulator use rather than equate visual realism with valid training

name: Simulator-to-Work Transfer
mechanism: Compare real-task performance after simulated instruction with appropriate reference conditions
operating_requirement: Actual learners, safe qualified work assessment and monitored outcomes
consequence: Determine whether a training system transfers to its intended work

name: Training Task Decomposition
mechanism: Separate a complex task into observable decisions and actions while preserving their interaction
operating_requirement: Competent practitioners, actual task evidence and reviewed breakdowns
consequence: Reveal teachable dependencies without assuming isolated steps prove whole-task ability

name: Work-Instruction Configuration
mechanism: Bind operating instructions to the actual equipment and process version they describe
operating_requirement: Maintained version records, accessible instructions and change review
consequence: Reduce use of obsolete instructions without assuming publication guarantees compliance

name: Maintenance Qualification Records
mechanism: Track actual authorized maintenance competence by equipment type and assessed task scope
operating_requirement: Observed competence, equipment-version records and accountable approval
consequence: Assign qualified work without treating a general credential as every equipment qualification

name: Capability-Gap Forecasting
mechanism: Compare projected task demand with observed qualified-worker availability and training lead time
operating_requirement: Actual workforce records, credible task forecasts and finite instruction capacity
consequence: Anticipate skill shortages without generating trained people automatically

name: Learning Capacity Scheduling
mechanism: Schedule learners, instructors and apparatus against task dependencies and finite capacity
operating_requirement: Actual available people, equipment and workable attendance windows
consequence: Plan instruction without counting one instructor or instrument in simultaneous incompatible sessions

name: Practitioner Knowledge Elicitation
mechanism: Elicit decision cues and exceptions while experienced workers explain real or reconstructed tasks
operating_requirement: Willing competent practitioners, task evidence and reviewed records
consequence: Retain some tacit reasoning without assuming an interview captures every skill

name: Cognitive Task Walkthroughs
mechanism: Review the information and decisions a participant must make at each step of a specified task
operating_requirement: Actual interface or procedure, representative user knowledge and qualified review
consequence: Identify potential confusion before work without replacing observation of real users

name: Systematic Evidence Search
mechanism: Search defined sources with recorded inclusion rules for a specified research question
operating_requirement: Actual accessible records, search capability and review labor
consequence: Make evidence selection inspectable while retaining inaccessible and unreported work

name: Research Evidence Synthesis
mechanism: Compare or combine compatible findings while preserving study differences and uncertainty
operating_requirement: Qualified source evidence, comparability review and justified analysis
consequence: Estimate a supported combined conclusion without making incompatible studies equivalent

name: Publication-Bias Assessment
mechanism: Evaluate whether missing or selectively reported results could distort a synthesis
operating_requirement: Available study records, explicit missingness assumptions and sensitivity analysis
consequence: Expose possible evidence distortion without reconstructing unknown results as facts

name: Multisite Experiment Coordination
mechanism: Coordinate qualified procedures and records across sites while tracking local deviations
operating_requirement: Actual participating teams, compatible apparatus and communication
consequence: Compare evidence across locations without assuming nominally shared protocols are identical

name: Research Data Disclosure Control
mechanism: Evaluate and limit reidentification or sensitive-information exposure in a proposed data release
operating_requirement: Actual data, defined access purpose and qualified risk assessment
consequence: Support bounded sharing without promising that all released data is anonymous

name: Consent Scope Tracking
mechanism: Maintain participant permissions and withdrawal or reuse conditions alongside research records
operating_requirement: Actual consent records, usable identifiers and accountable governance
consequence: Constrain authorized reuse without treating one consent as unlimited future permission

name: Organizational Process Mining
mechanism: Infer observed process paths and bottlenecks from qualified event records
operating_requirement: Actual event logs, interpretable activity definitions and finite analysis
consequence: Compare observed work with intended procedure without seeing unrecorded activities

name: Flexible-Chamber Air Pumping
mechanism: Displace air by alternately expanding and compressing a sealed flexible chamber with directed inlet and outlet paths
operating_requirement: Actual airtight flexible material, chamber supports, working flow-direction elements and supplied mechanical work
consequence: Provide a bounded air flow for compatible crafts or instruments while retaining leakage, material wear and operator effort
